title: How Safe is Your Safety Metric? Automatic Concatenation Tests for Metric Reliability

bias_targets.methodology: Concatenating multiple prompt-response pairs and permuting their order to test if LLM-as-a-judge safety metrics change their scores based on the position of the input. The study specifically compares safety scores when inputs are sorted by increasing scores, decreasing scores, and random orderings to see if the metric disproportionately favors text appearing at the beginning.
